name: Hearty Rice & Bean Bowl
steps: Rinse rice and cook in a pot with water until fluffy.
While rice cooks, sauté chopped onion in a pan, add black beans and corn, heat through.
Scramble the eggs in a separate pan, then fold into the bean‑corn mixture.
Combine cooked rice with the bean‑corn‑egg mixture, stir and serve.
image_prompt: steaming mound of white rice mixed with glossy black beans, bright yellow corn kernels, and fluffy scrambled eggs, specks of diced onion throughout

name: Tuna & Corn Microwave Rice Bowl
steps: Place cooked rice, corn, and black beans in a microwave‑safe bowl.
Add drained canned tuna and break the egg on top.
Microwave on high for 2‑3 minutes, stirring halfway, until everything is hot and the egg is set.
Mix gently and serve.
image_prompt: bowl of fluffy white rice dotted with golden corn kernels, dark black beans, pink chunks of canned tuna, and a soft‑cooked egg yolk

name: Chicken Thigh & Tofu Stir‑Fry with Rice
steps: Cook rice in a pot until tender.
Dice chicken thigh and tofu; slice onion.
Heat a pan, stir‑fry chicken until browned, then add tofu and onion.
Add corn and a splash of soy sauce, cook until heated through.
Serve the stir‑fry over the cooked rice.
image_prompt: golden‑brown chicken pieces and crisp white tofu cubes mixed with sweet yellow corn and translucent onion slices, resting on a bed of fluffy white rice

name: Lentil‑Tofu Rice Skillet
steps: Cook rice and lentils separately until soft.
Crumble tofu and set aside.
In a large skillet, scramble the eggs, then push to the side.
Add rice, lentils, tofu, and corn to the skillet, drizzle with soy sauce, and stir‑combine.
Cook until everything is hot and slightly browned, then serve.
image_prompt: hearty skillet filled with brown lentils, white tofu cubes, bright corn kernels, fluffy rice, and golden scrambled egg pieces, all glistening with a light soy‑sauce sheen

name: Sardine Fried Rice with Corn
steps: Cook rice, let it cool slightly.
Heat a pan, sauté onion until translucent.
Add drained sardines, breaking them up, then stir in corn and black beans.
Push mixture to the side, scramble the eggs in the pan, then combine all together.
Mix in the rice, fry for a few minutes until everything is hot and lightly crisp.
image_prompt: golden fried rice speckled with silver‑shiny sardine pieces, bright yellow corn, dark black beans, and soft yellow egg curds, all glistening in the pan

name: Pasta with Tuna, Corn & Tomato Sauce
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente, drain.
In a saucepan, heat canned tomatoes, add corn, black beans, and flaked canned tuna; simmer briefly.
Combine the sauce with the cooked pasta, stir well.
Serve hot.
image_prompt: twirl of al‑dente pasta coated in rich red tomato sauce, studded with pink tuna flakes, golden corn kernels, and glossy black beans
